name: Mechanical Engineering
totalCreditsNote: Confirmed 128 credit hours from the ME major page (resolves the earlier needs-verification flag). ABET-accredited BS.
notes: 128 credit-hour minimum; 2.0 GPA required both in ME courses and overall.
Many required courses are offered once a year and have prerequisite chains - the department requires following the published program schedule.
ULW is fulfilled by core lab (ME 240, 241) and design (ME 204, 205) courses, which cannot be taken at another university.

Cluster requirement is four courses: a 3-course approved humanities/social-science cluster plus one more humanities/social-science course (software/computer courses excluded); a humanities/social-science second major or minor also satisfies it.
Foundational equivalencies: CHEM 131 for CHEM 137; PHYS 113 or 141/142 for PHYS 121; MATH 14x/17x for 161/162 - captured where the app has the courses.

requirementGroups.label: Foundations (physics, EM, circuits)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: PHYS 122: Electricity and Magnetism; ... PHYS 121: Mechanics; ... OPT 210: Circuits

requirementGroups.label: Chemistry for engineers
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CHEM 137: Chemical Principles for Engineers* ... Students may take CHEM 131 in place of CHEM 137

requirementGroups.label: Calculus & linear algebra
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: MATH 161: Calculus 1A; MATH 162: Calculus IIA; MATH 164: Multidimensional Calculus; MATH 165: Linear Algebra and Differential Equations
requirementGroups.note: MATH 140-3 or 170-4 series may substitute for 161/162 per the page.

requirementGroups.label: Mechanical engineering core (16)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to take all of the following courses, following our program schedule: ME 121; ME 160; ME 204; ME 213; ME 225; ME 240; ME 280; ME 123; ME 205; ME 223; ME 226; ME 241; ME 251; ME 260; ME 110; ME 120

requirementGroups.label: Technical elective
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Students are required to complete one technical elective ... Biomedical engineering - Any course at the 200 level or higher except BME 201; Computer science - 170-173 and any 200+; Chemistry - 113 and any 200+; Electrical and computer engineering - 112, 114, 140 and any 200+; Mechanical engineering - any course not otherwise required; Optics - any 200+; Math - 150 and any 200+; Statistics - 212 and 213
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS nuance: per-department floors vary; modeled as a broad engineering/science filter.

requirementGroups.label: Natural science elective
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: All ME majors must complete one four-credit natural science course ... Astronomy - 111, 142 and any 200+; Biology - 110, 111, 198 and any 200+ EXCEPT BIO 214; Chemistry - 132 and any 200+; Earth and environmental science - ...; Math - 150 and any 200+; Physics - 103, 123, 143 and any 200+
requirementGroups.note: NEEDS nuance: per-department floors vary; modeled as a natural-science filter.

upperLevelWriting.label: Core lab and design courses (ME 204/205/240/241)
upperLevelWriting.sourceQuote: The upper-level writing requirement is fulfilled through upper-level laboratory courses (ME 240, ME 241) and design courses (ME 204, ME 205), all of which are core courses.
